SKIPPED: Yahoo exposes specific dated-contract tickers (confirmed reachable), but each individual contract only has a few years of listed trading history before expiry. Building a genuine multi-decade near/far carry series would require chaining ~100+ sequential contract-month tickers per market with correct roll-date logic -- a data-engineering effort disproportionate to this run, and error-prone in exactly the look-ahead/splicing-bug way this run is meant to guard against. A carry test restricted to the ~5-9 years where a single simultaneous near/far pair happens to overlap would fall below the runs own >=10-year evidence bar before it even started, so it is skipped rather than run and reported as a foregone-conclusion failure.
